texts.name: Katsue
texts.biography: Katsue is head-priestess of the temple of Banteki Reef. Long years of contemplative study have made her a cautious, patient individual who often counsels restrain and reflection when other urge action. Deeply committed to fortifying the pillars of Naga society - devotion to Shalassa, the Dragon of Water, respect to the Elders – Katsue places honour and duty above all other callings, and as such can make for a humourless, stick-in-the-mud companion.

specialty.name: Spring Spirits
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of allied Spring Spirits and Mizu-kamis by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
